question: Why do those who do not know fail to recognize the scriptural state?
premises: The distinctions of clarity and otherness in awareness become countless.
Because of this multiplicity, the underlying state is obscured.
Those who do not know therefore fail to recognize the state taught in the Shiva scriptures.
inference: The countless differentiations of awareness prevent the ignorant from recognizing the state described in the Shiva scriptures.
plain_english: The distinctions of clarity and otherness in awareness become countless; therefore those who do not know fail to recognize the state taught in the Shiva scriptures.
